failure_summary.description: Plans omitted or failed to apply required new constraints, refinements, or result-saving calls.
Plans reprocessed unchanged domains, assumed unavailable cache results, or used results for the wrong target or domain.
The plan imported unavailable tools and omitted the explicitly named attraction from its search.

patch.reasoning: The skill already directly covers these failures: apply pending deltas to compatible cached results, leave unchanged domains alone, verify exact cache coverage, save every tool result, call runtime tools directly, and preserve named attraction criteria. These trajectories violate existing instructions rather than reveal a missing generalizable rule, so additional text would be redundant.
